snippet.title: TEETER - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
TEETER is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to guide the balls down and make them land on the right platforms. Gray platforms have numbers on them that increase your score. Blue and red platforms can increase or decrease the amount of levers on which the ball rolls. You can flip the positions of the levers by pressing a button.

The game is over when you are out of levers.

Developed by Xitilon
Also released for PlayStation 5
